briefdescription.para: Track type IDs of contained types.

detaileddescription.para: Order is the same as the contained types of a Type*. This is used during upgrades of typed pointer IR in opaque pointer mode.

briefdescription.para: In some cases, we need to create a type ID for a type that was not explicitly encoded in the bitcode, or we don't know about at the current point.

detaileddescription.para: For example, a global may explicitly encode the value type ID, but not have a type ID for the pointer to value type, for which we create a virtual type ID instead. This map stores the new type ID that was created for the given pair of Type and contained type ID.

briefdescription.para: Allocator for BitcodeConstants.

detaileddescription.para: This should come before ValueList, because the ValueList might hold ValueHandles to these constants, so ValueList must be destroyed before Alloc.

briefdescription.para: The set of attributes by index.

detaileddescription.para: Index zero in the file is for null, and is thus not represented here. As such all indices are off by one.

briefdescription.para: The set of attribute groups.
While parsing a function body, this is a list of the basic blocks for the function.
When function bodies are initially scanned, this map contains info about where to find deferred function body in the stream.
When Metadata block is initially scanned when parsing the module, we may choose to defer parsing of the metadata.

detaileddescription.para: This vector contains info about which Metadata blocks are deferred.

briefdescription.para: These are basic blocks forward-referenced by block addresses.

detaileddescription.para: They are inserted lazily into functions when they're loaded. The basic block ID is its index into the vector.

briefdescription.para: These are Functions that contain BlockAddresses which refer a different Function.

detaileddescription.para: When parsing the different Function, queue Functions that refer to the different Function. Those Functions must be materialized in order to resolve their BlockAddress constants before the different Function gets moved into another Module.

briefdescription.para: Indicates that we are using a new encoding for instruction operands where most operands in the current FUNCTION_BLOCK are encoded relative to the instruction number, for a more compact encoding.

detaileddescription.para: Some instruction operands are not relative to the instruction ID: basic block numbers, and types. Once the old style function blocks have been phased out, we would not need this flag.

briefdescription.para: True if all functions will be materialized, negating the need to process (e.g.) blockaddress forward references.
Tracks whether we have seen debug intrinsics or records in this bitcode; seeing both in a single module is currently a fatal error.
